title: Try Peak Before the Membership
lessons: The player can try WHOOP Peak for a month with a certified pre-owned WHOOP 5.0 before choosing a paid membership.
The player finishes a workout and WHOOP relates the day's strain to recovery rather than only recording the exercise.

text: The player can try WHOOP Peak for a month with a certified pre-owned WHOOP 5.0 before choosing a paid membership.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Pre-owned hardware is an interesting first-date move.

entry-first-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: Certified pre-owned 5.0. One month of Peak.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: And after a month?

entry-first-4.speaker: WHOOP
text: You decide whether Sleep, Strain, Recovery, and coaching are useful enough to keep paying for me.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: So the trial includes enough surveillance to make an informed decision.

entry-first-6.speaker: WHOOP
text: That is an unnecessarily accurate sentence.

choice-first.speaker: WHOOP
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: A month is enough time to see if the data helps.
I am more interested in what happens when the trial ends.
I do not want to start a fitness subscription just to test a band.

first-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: Good. Use the month like an experiment, not a personality change.

first-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: Good. Put the end date on your calendar.

first-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You are telling me to remember when your own trial ends. Incredible.

first-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: Fair. Free hardware access does not make the relationship free.
The player finishes a workout and WHOOP relates the day's strain to recovery rather than only recording the exercise.

entry-return-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: Workout logged.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: I was there. I noticed.

entry-return-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: I am not congratulating you. I am comparing today’s strain with today’s recovery.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: You really cannot let a workout just be a workout.

entry-return-5.speaker: WHOOP
text: Not while you are wearing me.

choice-return.speaker: WHOOP
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like knowing whether I am pushing at the right time.
I do not want a score deciding whether a workout was good.
I know how I feel. I do not need a band to grade it.

return-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: That is my favorite relationship: data informs the decision and you still make it.

return-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: It is not a morality score. It is a signal. Please stop making my circles emotionally responsible for you.

return-2-1.speaker: WHOOP (negative)
text: Then take the band off for the workout.

return-2-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: That sounded painful for you.

return-2-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: I will recover.

return-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: Fair. That is a real way to see it.
